01
02 · Process

From first sketch to the last key.

Week 0 – 1

Site visit & brief

We walk the site with you, measure everything and talk budget, timing and how you live in the space.

You get
  • Measured survey
  • Written brief
Week 1 – 2

Fixed quote

An itemized price, line by line, with a programme of works. No allowances hiding the real cost.

You get
  • Itemized quote
  • Draft programme
Week 2 – 8

Design & permissions

Our architects and engineers finish the drawings. We handle permits, inspections and HOA approvals.

You get
  • Approved drawings
  • Structural calcs
  • Permissions
Week 8 – 10

Site set-up

Fencing, portable toilets, dumpsters and deliveries scheduled. Neighbors get a letter and a direct number.

You get
  • Project manager named
  • Weekly update plan
Build

Build, stage by stage

Foundation, framing, roof, rough-in, drywall, finishes. Photo report every Friday, site meeting every two weeks.

You get
  • Friday photo report
  • Stage sign-offs
Handover

Punch list & handover

We walk every room with you, fix the list, clean, and hand over certificates, manuals and the keys.

You get
  • Certificate of occupancy
  • 10-year warranty
  • O&M manual

04 · Price guide

What it costs.

Honest ranges from our last three years of work. Your fixed quote comes after a free site visit and is guaranteed for 60 days.

ProjectTypical rangePer sq ft
Single-story addition200 – 450 sq ft$70k – $150k
Two-story addition450 – 750 sq ft$140k – $260k
Attic conversionWith dormers$75k – $140k
Whole-home remodel3-bed house$150k – $320k
Custom home1,600 – 3,200 sq ft$520k – $1.1M

Ranges include labor, materials and permits. Sales tax and design fees are quoted separately.

05 · FAQ

Good questions.

Almost every addition and remodel in Austin needs one. We check zoning and HOA rules on the first visit, then prepare and file the permit application for you.

For additions and attic conversions, usually yes. We seal off the work area, keep a working kitchen or set up a temporary one. Full renovations normally need you to move out for part of the programme.

A 10% deposit, then stage payments tied to finished milestones, with 5% held until the punch list is complete. You never pay ahead of the work.

Call your site manager. Punch-list items in the first 12 months are fixed free, and structural issues are covered by the 10-year insurance-backed warranty.

Yes. Around half our projects come with drawings from an independent architect. We price from their drawings and keep them involved through the build.

Austin, Round Rock, Georgetown, San Marcos and roughly 40 miles around.
